responsibility: Implements lightweight redirected output for gm2 utilities. It manages the current output file, treats `-` and `<stdout>` as stdout, writes characters, plain strings, interned names, and numbers either directly through `FIO`/`SFIO` or into an in-memory dynamic-string buffer, and supports begin/end buffered capture so formatting code can build textual results without writing immediately to a stream.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation member of the Output pair, defining how writes go either to FIO/SFIO streams or an in-memory DynamicStrings buffer, whereas Output.def only declares those operations.
